question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
pred_sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
  SELECT
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.over_id,
    MIN(b.bowler) AS bowler_id,
    SUM(coalesce(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_in_over
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON b.match_id = s.match_id
   AND b.over_id = s.over_id
   AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id
   AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
match_max AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    MAX(runs_in_over) AS max_runs_in_match
  FROM over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
),
overs_with_match_max AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM over_runs o
  JOIN match_max m
    ON o.match_id = m.match_id
   AND o.runs_in_over = m.max_runs_in_match
),
-- For each bowler and match keep the runs_in_over (there may be multiple overs for same bowler in same match; keep the highest)
bowler_match_runs AS (
  SELECT
    ow.match_id,
    ow.bowler_id,
    MAX(ow.runs_in_over) AS runs_in_over
  FROM overs_with_match_max ow
  GROUP BY ow.match_id, ow.bowler_id
),
-- Now get each bowler's single highest such over across all matches
bowler_best AS (
  SELECT
    bmr.bowler_id,
    bmr.match_id,
    bmr.runs_in_over,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bmr.runs_in_over DESC) AS rk
  FROM bowler_match_runs bmr
)
SELECT
  bb.rk,
  p.player_id AS bowler_id,
  p.player_name AS bowler_name,
  bb.match_id,
  mch.match_date,
  bb.runs_in_over AS runs_conceded_in_over
FROM bowler_best bb
LEFT JOIN player p ON bb.bowler_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN "match" mch ON bb.match_id = mch.match_id
WHERE bb.rk <= 3
ORDER BY bb.runs_in_over DESC, bb.match_id

question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
pred_sql:
WITH
-- sum runs credited to batsman for each ball (0 if no record)
batsman_runs AS (
  SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, COALESCE(runs_scored,0) AS batsman_runs
  FROM batsman_scored
),
-- sum extras for each ball and classify whether they are charged to bowler.
-- For simplicity, we treat wide and noball as charged_to_bowler = 1 for noball (bowler charged)
-- and 0 for wide (not charged). Adjust mapping if your extra_type values differ.
extra_runs_charged AS (
  SELECT
    match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id,
    SUM(extra_runs) AS total_extras,
    -- mark runs charged to bowler: noball counts as charged, wide not charged.
    SUM(CASE WHEN extra_type = 'noball' THEN extra_runs ELSE 0 END) AS extras_charged_to_bowler
  FROM extra_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id
),
-- combine to compute runs conceded by bowler for each delivered legal/illegal ball record.
-- Note: wides are not charged to bowler here; noballs are charged. Batsman runs on wides will be in batsman_runs (usually 0).
runs_per_ball AS (
  SELECT
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.over_id,
    b.ball_id,
    COALESCE(br.batsman_runs, 0) AS batsman_runs,
    COALESCE(er.total_extras, 0) AS total_extras,
    COALESCE(er.extras_charged_to_bowler, 0) AS extras_charged_to_bowler
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_runs br USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs_charged er USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
),
-- attach bowler to each ball
ball_with_bowler AS (
  SELECT
    rpb.*,
    bb.bowler
  FROM runs_per_ball rpb
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
),
-- total runs conceded per bowler: batsman runs + extras charged to bowler
bowler_runs AS (
  SELECT
    bowler AS player_id,
    SUM(batsman_runs + extras_charged_to_bowler) AS total_runs
  FROM ball_with_bowler
  GROUP BY bowler
),
-- total wickets per bowler (join wickets to ball_by_ball to get bowler)
bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    bb.bowler AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb
    ON w.match_id = bb.match_id
   AND w.innings_no = bb.innings_no
   AND w.over_id = bb.over_id
   AND w.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
-- combine and compute average, exclude zero-wicket bowlers
bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(br.total_runs,0) AS total_runs,
    bw.wickets,
    CAST(COALESCE(br.total_runs,0) AS REAL) / bw.wickets AS bowling_average
  FROM bowler_wickets bw
  LEFT JOIN bowler_runs br USING (player_id)
  JOIN player p USING (player_id)
  WHERE bw.wickets > 0
)
SELECT player_id, player_name, total_runs, wickets, bowling_average
FROM bowler_stats
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1
